attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-api as a systemd-managed service on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04, 999M RAM, no swap) with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000, and proved that when a memory hog drives the system out of memory, the kernel's OOM killer selects the hog (default oom_score_adj=0, oom_score 893) while inventory-api (protected, oom_score_adj=-1000) keeps serving. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: boot identity changed and the service auto-recovered via systemd enablement.
